messages:
marie: Heads up — reproducible double-retry in our Android sample app when token refresh races with concurrent requests on emulator. Happened running Retrofit+OkHttp (okhttp3 4.9.3).

sam: ugh. do you have logs or a minimal repro?

marie: short log snippet:
```
2026-03-20 11:14:02.123 I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/generate
2026-03-20 11:14:02.234 I/Auth: 401, refreshing token
2026-03-20 11:14:02.235 I/OkHttp: --> POST /v1/generate
2026-03-20 11:14:02.340 I/OkHttp: got 401 again
```

marie: interceptor order is AuthInterceptor then RetryInterceptor. AuthInterceptor triggers refresh + replays call, but concurrent calls race and both refresh. Here's simplified interceptor:
```
class AuthInterceptor: Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .header("Authorization", "Bearer ${tokenManager.token}")
      .build()
    val resp = chain.proceed(req)
    if (resp.code == 401) {
      tokenManager.refresh() // not synchronized
      val retryReq = req.newBuilder()
        .header("Authorization", "Bearer ${tokenManager.token}")
        .build()
      return chain.proceed(retryReq)
    }
    return resp
  }
}
```

alex: yeah classic. two quick fixes: 1) synchronize refresh so only one thread refreshes, other threads wait; 2) move refresh logic into an Authenticator (OkHttp Authenticator) which runs on follow-up and de-dupes automatically.

joan: note: Authenticator runs during followup processing and gets the prior response. It's preferable because OkHttp will attach follow-up to the same call. Also avoid re-calling chain.proceed from interceptors after reading body — can cause duplication.

sam: also saw the emulator flakiness — when you toggle airplane mode, retries spike. Add jitter to your exponential backoff. sample:
```
fun jitteredBackoff(attempt: Int): Long {
  val base = (2.0.pow(attempt.toDouble()) * 100).toLong()
  val jitter = Random.nextLong(0, base / 2)
  return base + jitter
}
```

marie: thanks — implementing synchronized refresh + jitter reduced duplicates in our sample perf test from ~20% to <1%.

alex: another gotcha: Retrofit's CallAdapter for coroutines can cancel underlying call on coroutine cancel -> triggers retry if cancel isn't handled. Wrap with isActive checks.

joan: and FYI, on API <24, some OEMs aggressively kill background threads during network changes; recommend testing on low-memory devices too.

ci-bot: deploy log: sample-app-integration-tests: flaky auth-race tests marked unstable — investigating.

sam: can you push a tiny repro branch? I'll run on my Pixel 3 and emulator x86_64.

marie: pushed branch st/auth-race-jitter — has synchronized refresh via Mutex + OkHttp Authenticator fallback. includes unit test that simulates concurrent calls.

sam: great. will run and report back. :thumbsup:
